title: Assets Manifest
description: Manifest of all reference image files (PNGs) that exist outside git. Used by scripts/sync_assets.py to verify and sync images from external storage.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the manifest was generated.

project_id.description: Project ID from project.yaml, for sanity checking.

path.description: Relative path from project root (e.g. characters/alyssa/ref_front.png). Uses forward slashes.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the file contents.

asset_type.description: Whether this image belongs to a character or environment.

ref_id.description: Reference ID from the entity's YAML config (e.g. 'ref_front'). Optional — not all PNGs may map to a named reference.

purpose.description: Purpose tag from the YAML reference (e.g. 'front_neutral', 'establishing_shot').
